- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/fa00193c31fcd3f2

* [Core Event] SK Hynix Inc., South Korean Government: Construction of the 'Trinity Fab' and 2 trillion KRW in loan guarantees
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] To bridge the validation gap for local small-to-mid-sized equipment vendors and strengthen national semiconductor supply chain autonomy
* [Key Metrics] $654M investment for Trinity Fab facility, supplemented by 2 trillion KRW in guarantees focused on 12-inch wafer processes.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Outlook: Strengthening vertical integration and increasing the share of domestic equipment in advanced process lines.
